scope: Shared event vocabulary applied symmetrically to the Q0 manual baseline and later assisted-shaped reviews; frozen in shape before any Q0 data collection.
digest_convention: sha256 of compact sorted UTF-8 JSON of this object excluding the record_digest field; non-self-referential; no source-content bytes are digested.

actors.ANALYST: Human analyst performing or reviewing the workflow in the manual lane.
actors.ASSISTED_AGENT_UNDER_ANALYST_REVIEW: Assisted-lane actor whose events carry identical semantics and remain under analyst review; not an authoritative calculator or approver.

symmetry_rule: Every event definition applies to both lanes with identical start/end semantics, scope, unit, and exclusions. The measurement method never changes between the manual and assisted lanes.

successor_version_semantics.rule: Changing any event definition creates a successor vocabulary_version. Earlier emitted event results are never rewritten and remain bound to the vocabulary_version under which they were collected.

overhead_rule: instrumentation_overhead time is recorded separately and excluded from analytic-work metrics; a workflow whose instrumentation overhead is not measurable invalidates the affected comparison.

events.description: Reading an in-scope source document for the workflow.

actor_applicability.note: Identical timing, scope, unit, and exclusion semantics in both lanes; lane differs only by actor.

events.start_semantics: First open/attention on the source document for this workflow step.
events.end_semantics: Attention leaves the document or the read is marked complete.
events.scope: One source document within one workflow step.
exclusions: idle time away from the workstation

correction_lineage.correction_note: A correction emits a new event referencing the corrected event_id via supersedes_event_id; earlier emitted events are never rewritten.

events.end_semantics: Exact location recorded and attached to the observation.
events.scope: One observed result to one exact source location.
